personalInfo.bio: Frontend-focused Software Engineer with 6+ years of experience specializing in React, TypeScript, and web performance. Actively expanding into Full Stack architecture by building scalable Node.js services, with a core professional focus on Core Web Vitals, System Design, and zero-runtime CSS.
personalInfo.detailedBio: I am a Software Engineer with over 6 years of professional experience, currently specializing in Frontend Architecture and Performance. While my foundation is deeply rooted in React, TypeScript, and state management (Redux, Zustand, React Query), my personal projects involve building full-stack applications using Node.js and Express to bridge the gap toward System Design. At the enterprise level, I focus on optimizing Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS), establishing robust private NPM libraries, and implementing clean, component-based architectures. My engineering philosophy prioritizes a deep understanding of browser internals and the event loop over surface-level pattern matching, ensuring my code is scalable, reliable, and strictly typed.

education.description: Intensive full-stack web development bootcamp that teaches the fundamentals of programming across the front-end and back-end. Gained knowledge about React, Redux, Node, Express. Worked in a team of four members to build a meal delivery website.

Studied many engineering topics, including digital communication, digital signal processing, real-time applications, robotics, and nanotechnology. Also studied computer science topics, such as computer architecture design, microprocessor applications, model-driven software, and formal hardware verification.

experience.description: Led development and maintenance of various projects using React, Typescript, Styled components, React Router, antd library, Redux Toolkit, and react-query. Developed expertise in additional skills such as building and maintain NPM(private) libraries.

Worked collaboratively in a team of 4 to develop web applications using React, Material-UI for the frontend, and Express, Node, MongoDB, Cloudinary Image uploader, and JWT authentication for the backend.

Assisted in developing iOS and Android mobile apps using Expo, TypeScript, Jest, and React Native. Gained hands-on backend experience with Node.js and Express by building and consuming REST APIs and applying core patterns like routing, controllers, and middleware to support the web app rebuild.

projects.title: Productify: Full-Stack TypeScript Product Platform
projects.excerpt: A real-world PERN-style build where I implemented end-to-end auth with Clerk, ownership-safe product/comment CRUD, and cache-aware React Query flows to keep UX fast without excessive refetching.

projects.title: zsk-react-i18n: Typed React Localization Wrapper
projects.excerpt: A reusable npm package that wraps i18next/react-i18next with a type-safe API for React apps. I built both factory and direct-provider modes, runtime language guards, localStorage persistence, multi-language scaling, and compile-time translation-key safety backed by tests.
